shared: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent raster animation sprite sheet for a side scrolling pencil doodle arcade game. Bold black ink outlines, richly textured colored pencil hatching, whimsical menacing cartoon, readable clean silhouette. Exactly 16 separate complete poses in a precise evenly spaced 4-column by 4-row grid, read left to right top to bottom. Square canvas. Every cell has generous transparent padding, no frame crossing, no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no text, labels, numbers, borders, watermark or grid lines. True alpha transparency. All living poses face LEFT in side view, same identity, costume and proportions in every cell, no camera rotation or cropping. Rows 1 and 2: eight genuinely different locomotion poses completing one cycle. Row 3: four attack poses, windup, anticipation, release, follow-through. Row 4: four distinct non-gory defeat poses, recoil, buckle, collapse, final wreck; keep the whole final remains visible. Keep limbs inside their own cells. Match a hand drawn colored pencil monster platformer, not smooth vector or pixel art.
tagger: Level 1 rooftop enemy: Spray Skater, a small orange cockroach punk in a backward turquoise cap, riding a battered purple skateboard, grasping a magenta spray can. Clearly insect silhouette, two antennae, expressive huge eyes, four tiny arms, two feet on board. Locomotion: pushing and cruising, bent knees and moving antennae. Attack: shakes and aims spray can left, sprays a bright pink paint glob, skids backward from recoil. Defeat: startled recoil, tumbles off board, sprawls with board tipped, flattened dazed bug beside fallen board. All airborne accessories stay close inside each cell.
bellkeeper: Level 2 graveyard enemy: Bone Bellkeeper, a squat walking tarnished brass funeral bell with a single skull face in the bell mouth, two bony arms and two skeletal feet, a torn teal ribbon on the handle. Not a ghost, not a robed humanoid. Locomotion: weighty alternating bone-foot steps with bell tilting subtly. Attack: raises a bone hammer, winds up, strikes its own bell rim with turquoise spectral vibration rings, finishes ringing. Defeat: cracked startled bell, feet buckle, bell falls on its side, final broken brass bell with loose bones and fading teal glimmer. No detached giant effects.
boiler: Level 3 furnace enemy: Boiler Crab, a wide squat six legged industrial crab with riveted charcoal iron boiler shell, glowing amber furnace mouth, copper steam pipes and one large orange coal shovel claw. Distinct heavy low crustacean silhouette. Locomotion: six leg skitter cycle, small puffs from pipes inside cell. Attack: opens furnace hatch, shovel lifts one glowing round coal bomb, lobs it LEFT and exhales sparks, closes hatch. Defeat: shell cracks with sparks, legs buckle, rolls onto side, final cooling cracked boiler wreck and folded legs. No gore, no scenery.
mantis: Level 4 enchanted forest enemy: Thorn Mantis, a tall lime green praying mantis with an acorn shoulder guard, dark green leaf wings, thorny curved forearms and luminous yellow eyes. Thin insect silhouette with long angular jointed rear legs, no ghost or spider silhouette. Locomotion: elegant stalking walk with alternating legs and slightly opening leaf wings. Attack: curls one forearm, winds a serrated leaf blade back, throws the crescent leaf LEFT, follows through with empty claw extended. Defeat: startled broken stance, knees fold, falls sideways, final crumpled leaves and curled mantis. Non-gory. Maintain same scale across poses.
prism: Level 5 spaceship enemy: Prism Ray, a biomechanical space manta shaped ship with broad diamond wings, pearl white armored plates with black pencil outlines, cyan glass core and three triangular magenta prism emitters at its LEFT facing nose. No humanoid body. Engine tail to RIGHT. Side view with readable swept manta silhouette, thin wing fins. Locomotion: eight gentle fin undulation and cyan thruster pulse poses, no rotating viewpoint. Attack: fins fold, magenta core charges, three short parallel pink laser flashes fire LEFT, core dims and fins relax. Defeat: armor cracks, wings break with contained sparks, crumples into pieces, final compact drifting shattered pearl and cyan wreck. Every pose complete and inside its own cell.
mimic: Level 6 cosmic void enemy: Rift Maw, a squat living purple meteor treasure chest monster with one huge cyan slit eye on the lid, obsidian crystal corners, stubby three toed legs and jagged pale teeth inside its hinged mouth. No humanoid, no ghost. Locomotion: waddles on alternating feet, lid slightly opens and closes, small violet wisps kept close to body. Attack: crouches with lid shut, mouth opens vertically with glowing cyan core, spits a tight cross of four small violet star shards, lid snaps shut. Defeat: lid jerks back cracked, legs buckle, body caves inward, final shattered obsidian chest with dim cyan eye. Non-gory with recognizable remains. Face LEFT throughout all living poses.

refinements.mantis: Identity reference: initial mantis sheet. Recreate entire 4x4 sheet with all characters, bent claws, small thrown leaf, antennae and wings inside the central 65 percent width and 80 percent height of each cell; generous transparent padding everywhere. No motion trails or extended swipes. Eliminate all neighboring-cell overflow. Same character scale and facing.
refinements.prism: Identity reference: initial Prism Ray sheet. Recreate entire 4x4 sheet, every ship, fin, thruster, short firing beam and wreck fragment within central 65 percent width and 75 percent height of each cell, generous transparent padding everywhere. Firing beams at most 15 percent ship length; no large halo, no long trails, no neighboring-cell overflow. Same ship scale and LEFT facing side view.
